problem.text: The manifest explicitly included Hadamard data but not the native extension tree, leaving JIT installation without an explicit packaging rule for its build inputs.

reasoning.text: JIT compilation needs source files after installation, not just during package construction: ext.py locates exllamav3_ext beside itself and recursively collects C, C++ and CUDA sources.

impact.text: The added recursive inclusion rule addresses distribution of the native build inputs without changing compilation flags, native code or extension-loading behavior.

source_notes.text: The initial implementation's explanation already identifies precompiled and JIT installation paths and the original Hadamard-only manifest inclusion.

limitations: No source distribution, wheel, installation or JIT compilation was executed; actual artifact contents and successful compilation remain unverified.
A scalar computation would not meaningfully validate this manifest change; its consequential behavior depends on packaging and native-build tooling.

chapters.title: Ship native inputs for deferred compilation

claims.text: MANIFEST.in preserves the Hadamard-data rule and adds `recursive-include exllamav3/exllamav3_ext *`. The wildcard covers the extension tree broadly rather than restricting inclusion to compiled translation-unit suffixes.

setup.py enables include_package_data and supplies CUDAExtension only when precompilation is enabled and Torch is available. Presence of EXLLAMA_NOCOMPILE disables precompilation regardless of its value, so this installation route cannot rely on that extension declaration to describe its sources.

At runtime, ext.py first imports the prebuilt extension. On ModuleNotFoundError it instead walks the package-local extension directory for .c, .cpp and .cu files and passes them to torch.utils.cpp_extension.load, together with that directory as an include path.

Explicitly shipping the entire tree supports deferred compilation and its accompanying include files independently of setup-time precompilation. The tradeoff is broader packaged content than a suffix-limited source list; the existing prebuilt-extension route remains available.

annotation.summary: Adds recursive manifest inclusion of the native extension tree so JIT installations can carry their deferred compilation inputs.
